rental deposit process**\n\nI realize there's a potential missing requirement regarding the formal rent deposit process in Article 259g. It requires tenants to notify landlords in writing and set a reasonable period while threatening the deposit. The existing document seems to address repair deadlines but doesn't mention the necessary threat to deposit, which is critical for my workflow. So, I think it might be good to include a “Written notice threatening rent deposit” document to clearly outline these requirements.**Clarifying document requirements**\n\nThe workflow document titled \"written_repair_deadline\" needs to display the repair deadline, recipient, and notice contents, which may imply a threat but isn't stated clearly. We should avoid adding duplicates. While I could propose a document titled \"Written notice setting reasonable deadline and announcing rent deposit (Art. 259g OR),\" it might overlap with existing requirements.
